enrichment.headline: Pays NV5 up to $239,800 for solar project advisory services through June 2026
enrichment.summary: The district hires NV5 Consultants, Inc. to provide renewable energy owner's advisory services for its Phase 2 and 3 solar (photovoltaic, or PV) projects, as described in an exhibit to the agreement. The not-to-exceed amount is $239,800.00. Work starts September 26, 2024 and is expected to last until June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement – NV5 Consultants, Inc. - Oakland Unified School District Phase 2 and 3 PV Projects – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $5,585.71 for 14 more workstations in the central office move, Building Block Interiors
enrichment.summary: This amendment has Building Block Interiors, Inc. install 14 additional workstations and five panels for the Central Office Consolidation Move Project. It adds $5,585.71, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $57,625.00 to $63,210.71, and extends the term to December 31, 2024. The earlier term ended August 31, 2024, before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No.1, Purchase Agreement - Building Block Interiors, Inc. - Central Office Consolidation Move Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Extends HERTZ Environmental's Cole Administrative Center stormwater work to June 2025, no added money
enrichment.summary: This amendment keeps HERTZ Environmental, Inc. on for continued Storm Water Pollution Plan and environmental services at the Cole Administrative Center Project. It only extends the term, to June 30, 2025 (319 more days), and adds no money. The earlier term ended August 15, 2024, before this vote.
